item.title: Protests against CEC Gyanesh Kumar: Over 700 detained in Delhi, thousands attend CJP stir in Mumbai - top developments
item.description: Demonstrations are intensifying in Delhi and Mumbai, with protesters calling for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over perceived electoral roll issues. Approximately 700 individuals were detained in Delhi at Jantar Mantar. Meanwhile, thousands defied police orders to gather at Shivaji Park in Mumbai. Protests also spread to other cities, including Ahmedabad, Lucknow, and Patna, highlighting a growing movement.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: Lawyers’ body forms panel to review SIR: Ex-SC, HC judges to examine ‘constitutional & statutory validity’
item.description: A panel of five former judges is being formed to review the Election Commission's Special Intensive Revision. The Lawyers Association for Constitution emphasizes the panel's independence in assessing the review's validity and impact. Senior lawyers are expected to provide strategic legal advice to the panel throughout the process. The Election Commission has also initiated a drive to identify and re-enrol excluded eligible voters.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: BJP government made Haryana number one in drugs, corruption, crime: Hooda
item.description: In a passionate speech at the Congress Block Workers' Conference in Tauru, Bhupinder Singh Hooda slammed the BJP government, claiming that under its leadership, Haryana has seen a grave decline in both development and safety. He highlighted the state's dismal performance in crime rates and economic growth, attributing this downturn to the BJP's neglect over the past 12 years.
item.dc:creator: Mahima Sharma

item.title: India’s diversity, traditional knowledge can help build better world: RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat
item.description: RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat highlighted Bharat's identity rooted in its languages, faiths, and cultures during a recent address. He emphasized the need for youth to be educated about Indian traditions while integrating global knowledge. Bhagwat referred to responses from an interfaith meeting, emphasizing universal truths shared by various philosophies. He encouraged passing on Bharat's identity and values to future generations.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: Pargat Singh replaces Warring as Punjab Congress chief: Who he is and why Congress chose him
item.description: Pargat Singh has been chosen as the new president of the Punjab Pradesh Congress Committee. He replaces Amrinder Singh Raja Warring, who resigned amid party factional tensions. With the 2027 assembly elections approaching, Congress seeks to unify its internal divisions. Singh’s political experience as an MLA and former minister provides valuable legislative insights. His association with sports also aims to engage a younger voter base effectively.
item.dc:creator: Ayush Pandey

item.title: Rahul Gandhi demands CEC Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation as protests erupt in Delhi, Mumbai
item.description: Rahul Gandhi has called for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation during ongoing protests. These protests arose over allegations of irregularities in the electoral-roll revision exercise. Approximately 700 protesters were detained in Delhi while trying to gather near Jantar Mantar for the demonstrations. Additional protests took place in Mumbai, where various groups demanded Kumar's resignation and accountability.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: Akhilesh Yadav's Rajya Sabha picks: Samajwadi Party's master strategy or 'PDA' contradiction?
item.description: Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav's Rajya Sabha picks, including uncle Ram Gopal Yadav and Reliance executive Dhanraj Parimal Nathwani, are being seen as an early test for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly polls. The nominations raise questions over the SP's PDA strategy, its broader political outreach and a possible third Rajya Sabha candidate, despite the party's numbers falling short of the winning quota.
item.dc:creator: Pallavi

item.title: Warring out, Pargat Singh in: Has Congress solved Punjab crisis or created more confusion?
item.description: Amarinder Singh Raja Warring has resigned as the president of the Punjab Congress after more than four years. His resignation follows a prolonged period of infighting over leadership roles within the party. Both Charanjit Singh Channi and Warring have seen shifts in their status amid ongoing power struggles. But has Congress really solved the Punjab crisis?
item.dc:creator: Priyanka Mukherjee

item.title: From papads to pitches: NCERT brings startup lessons to Class IX
item.description: A new chapter on startups and entrepreneurship has been introduced for Class IX students in NCERT textbooks. The chapter emphasizes the growth of India's startup ecosystem over the past decade. It includes important lessons on identifying business opportunities and creating effective business plans. Entrepreneurial stories, including those of Lijjat Papad and Mohan Singh Oberoi, illustrate key concepts.
item.dc:creator: Manash Pratim Gohain

item.title: Evening news wrap: India women’s hockey team wins Asian Games gold; CJP's Abhijeet Dipke launches ‘Jail Bharo Andolan’ & more
item.description: India’s women’s hockey team secured the Asian Games gold medal by defeating China 1-0 in the final. Abhijeet Dipke initiated a "Jail Bharo Andolan" in Mumbai over alleged electoral issues, calling for the election chief's resignation. A Flydubai mid-air incident was termed a 'terrorist act,' with praise for the Indian pilot's actions. Amarinder Singh Raja Warring resigned as Punjab Congress chief after years of leadership amid factional dissent.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: 'May Bapu’s timeless message keep guiding us': PM Modi pays tribute to Mahatma Gandhi, attends prayer meet
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi participated in a special interfaith prayer meeting to honor Mahatma Gandhi's birth anniversary. He paid floral tributes at Gandhi Smriti and Rajghat earlier in the day. PM Modi emphasized Gandhi's ideals of truth, peace, and non-violence while urging people to adopt Swadeshi. Vice President CP Radhakrishnan also attended and remembered Gandhi's contributions to India's freedom movement.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: 2 Jharkhand yoga instructors killed in Vietnam road accident; bodies to be brought back on Oct 3
item.description: Tragedy struck as two beloved yoga instructors, Raja Kumar and Vinay Kumar Rai, lost their lives in a tragic road accident in Vietnam. The financial burden of repatriating their remains prompted an outpouring of support from the local community. In a gesture of assistance, the Jharkhand government pledged Rs 5 lakh for each family.
item.dc:creator: Mahima Sharma

item.title: Gandhi Jayanti: Mamata says stronger India must be guided by Bapu’s ideals
item.description: On Gandhi Jayanti, Mamata Banerjee paid tribute to Mahatma Gandhi, underscoring his timeless principles for strengthening India. She emphasized that his messages of truth, simplicity, and service are essential for national advancement. Additionally, Abhishek Banerjee honored Gandhi’s unwavering dedication to truth, justice, and equality. Together, they urged for an inclusive nation where respect for citizens' rights and dignity is upheld, underpinned by the guiding principles of the Constitution.
item.dc:creator: Mahima Sharma
